floor_history.headline: Recon: engine floor 17 is CHEAT-INFLATED — the HEAD form's volatile-coerced cosA read is not stripped by the sandbox; the honest cheat-free floor is 26, and it decomposes into exactly two independent

frontier.hypothesis: The raw cosA halfword has a second, flow-LIVE use of the zero-extended value in the original source, which is what stops combine folding lhu+sll+sra into lh.
frontier.mechanism: combine's simplify_shift_const only rewrites ashiftrt(ashift(zero_extend(mem))) -> sign_extend(mem) when the zero_extend dest is single-use and dead after the chain (dead_or_set_p). A purely dead second use cannot help: GCC 2.7.2 runs flow's dead-code deletion BEFORE combine. Matched precedent func_80065344 keeps its lhu because the u16 is stored back.
frontier.next_probe: m2c the target block and diff the same region in the two family siblings (_SelectSection, hirahira_w_ctrl_2 — the latter has the signature twice) to find what live consumer the original had; specifically test whether the sign-extended value reaches the four multiplies through a DIFFERENT C variable than the load's destination (two variables rather than one), which gives the load's dest a natural second reader.

frontier.hypothesis: angC can be steered into $v1 (freeing $v0 for the index temp and then, after the temp dies, for sinAxsinB_12) by changing the local-alloc quantity priority of angC vs its index temp — closing 13 of the 26 diffs.
frontier.mechanism: local-alloc assigns by quantity priority (reg_n_refs and live-range length), and the assignment happens at lreg (greg insn 44 already shows the hard reg). Declaration order is measured inert, so the lever must change relative ref-count / live length.
frontier.next_probe: Split the cos-index chain '((s16)angC + 0x400) & 0xFFF' into its own named local so angC's live range ends earlier; and separately compute the sin index through a named local so the temp becomes the longer-lived quantity. Read .lreg 'used N times across M insns' for both quantities before/after; escalate to BB2_ALLOC_DEBUG / BB2_PRIO_DEBUG-instrumented cc1 if the counts do not explain the tie-break.

frontier.hypothesis: The closing form is a family-level source idiom shared by all three 3x3 rotation-matrix functions in src/text1a_c.c, not a per-function local detail.
frontier.mechanism: All three carry regfix rules describing the same two mechanisms (sinAxsinB_12 in $a0-vs-$v0, and the volatile/la addressing block for the cosA read); a mechanism present in all three is a property of the original source spelling of the shared idiom.
frontier.next_probe: Diff the three targets' Judge-read prologues instruction-by-instruction and diff the three C bodies; identify which one has the SMALLEST cheat-free distance and prototype the idiom there first (cheaper gradient), then port the winning spelling to this function.
